A Love Story
22
Years of Forever
Us, Always
9th May · 2004 — 2026
Chapter I · The Beginning
"The moment I saw you, I knew — this was the beginning of my greatest story."
May 9th, 2003. Standing beside you, I made a promise — not just with words, but with every heartbeat that followed. That day became the most beautiful day of my life.
Page 01 of 10
Chapter II · My Shelter
"In your arms, I found a home nothing else could offer."
Through every season of life, you have been my constant. Your laughter is the sound of everything good. Your embrace is where the world quiets down, and all that matters is that we are together.
Page 02 of 10
Chapter III · Quiet Moments
"The conversations we don't need words for — those are my favourite."
Sitting beside you on those river rocks, the mountains behind us, the world rushing past — I realised that happiness isn't a destination. It is simply being next to you.
Page 03 of 10
Chapter IV · Every Celebration
"Every festival is brighter because you are in it."
The diyas, the quiet lawn, the way you look in the soft glow of the night — these moments are stitched into my heart permanently. With you, ordinary evenings become poetry.
Page 04 of 10
Chapter V · The Little Things
"It is the small acts of love that write the most beautiful chapters."
You knelt beside me on the riverbank, tying my shoes so I wouldn't slip on the stones. I didn't say it enough then — that single gesture told me everything I ever needed to know about who you are.
Page 05 of 10
Chapter VI · My Proudest Moments
"Walking beside you is the greatest privilege I have ever known."
At every gathering, in every room we enter together, I look at you and think — this person chose me. And in choosing me, you made me the luckiest person alive. You are my pride.
Page 06 of 10
Chapter VII · Adventures We've Lived
"Anywhere with you is my favourite place on earth."
The mountains, the rivers, the winding roads — every journey is sweeter because you are beside me. You make the entire world feel like an adventure worth having. Here's to all the roads still ahead of us.
Page 07 of 10
Chapter VIII · Our Greatest Creation
"We didn't just build a life — we built a family."
They are us — in every laugh, every stubborn moment, every hug that squeezes too tight. Our children are the proof that love, when real, creates something extraordinary.
Page 08 of 10
Chapter IX · Still & Always
"Twenty-two years and I am still falling for you."
They said the butterflies fade. They were wrong. The way you look at me — across rooms, across years — still catches my breath. Twenty-two years have not dulled a single thing. If anything, I love you more precisely now, with all the knowledge of who you truly are.
Page 09 of 10
Chapter X · The Promise
♥
"Here is to twenty-two more,
and every lifetime after that."
Thank you for being my partner, my best friend, my safe place. Thank you for the laughter and the tears we've weathered together. Thank you for choosing me — every single day, for twenty-two years.

With all my love, today and always.
9th May 2003 — 9th May 2025
